title: C4.1.6 coding band: R50 and above
notes: Engine helper, not a published table: true where the clause's coding band applies, false otherwise (default false). Used as a condition inside the concession exceptions on C4.1.1 (a table-lookup with no fact answers MEETS when the value is truthy), because exceptions cannot carry a coding of their own. Values are never null. Chapter 4 Part 1 covers R10-R60 only. C4.1.6: gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R50 and above (R50-R60 in this chapter).
